decisions.reason: Exporting existing work to the new account does not change the requirement that the duplicate omit its pricing section.
The account-transfer method does not change the monthly marker text, typography, or coverage.
Transferring work between Kajabi accounts does not change the required duplicate artifact or its duplication timing.
The workspace transfer instruction does not alter the two-panel pricing layout or its restyling rule.
Moving existing work to the new account does not change which Q&A box must be absent.
The transfer method does not change the secondary control label or required coverage.
The account migration instruction does not alter the control's placement below the primary button.
Exporting and uploading the page does not change the secondary control's wrapper or visual styling requirements.
The transfer instruction does not change the requirement that the bonus section be removed.
Moving the existing page between accounts does not change the expected alignment of the instructor section.
The account-transfer method does not modify any top-block layout expectation.
The transfer instruction does not change the required video replacement or playback behavior.
